# Asana

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark (declared in the shipped CSS, unbound on the captured routes)` theme, and keeps the 10 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: SaaS marketing + product surfaces: near-white page, near-black #0d0d0d ink, Segoe UI, 3px control radii, near-black primary CTAs lifting to #3d3d3d, #f3f3f3 panels with #cfcfcf hairlines, and a full shipped token layer ; colour ramps, --lightmode-*/--darkmode-* roles, 16px spacing base, --media-* breakpoints, 12-col grid, --shadow-* and --transition-* scales.

Captured 2026-11-11, signed out (every captured surface is public; the app on app.asana.com sits behind sign-in and was never reached; OneTrust consent banner was dismissed). Themes: light, dark (declared in the shipped CSS, unbound on the captured routes).

A token set and component reference for Asana's public marketing site (https://asana.com), a Next.js site for a work/project-management product. Use it to build a marketing or product surface that borrows its look: a near-white page, near-black ink `#0d0d0d` on headings and `#3d3d3d` body text, Segoe UI throughout, 3px control radii, near-black `#0d0d0d` primary buttons that lift to `#3d3d3d` on hover, `#f3f3f3` panels, `#cfcfcf` hairlines, and a full shipped design token layer — colour ramps (`--black-20..1100`, `--blue-0..980`, `--coral-*`, `--bright-*`), `--lightmode-*` semantic roles, a 16px-base `--spacing-*` scale, `--media-*` breakpoints, 12-column grid, `--shadow-10..40` and `--transition-*` durations. It was captured signed out, in headless Chromium at 1440 x 900 (mobile at 390 x 844) on 2026-11-11.

It holds 19 screenshots across seven routes — /, /pricing, /product/ai, /features, /resources, /sales, /create-account — plus transient states (the nav flyout open, a pricing FAQ open, the mobile menu open), and 21 measured components with 60+ states and one crop each. The product itself (app.asana.com, workspaces, every Launch/Log in/Get started path) sits behind sign-in and was never reached: the app is recorded as a boundary, and nothing here claims its functionality. One capture note: the site ships a full `--darkmode-*` role set in its CSS, but every captured route paints light — the dark set is emitted as declared evidence, not a painted page (see [components.md](components.md) > Gaps).

This package contains no Asana code, and none of its artwork has been redrawn. The screenshots, product imagery and visual system they show belong to Asana ([docs/RIGHTS.md](../../docs/RIGHTS.md)). Borrow structure and proportions, not the logo, artwork or brand assets.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.
